## v6.1.0

### ✨ Highlights

This release adds smart client handoffs: the client listens for Redis maintenance notifications, relaxes command and socket timeouts while maintenance is in progress and moves connections to the new endpoint, so planned upgrades and failovers on Redis Enterprise and Redis Cloud cause fewer errors. Cluster sharded Pub/Sub gets a health check that detects subscribers which stop receiving messages and reconnects them. The command set grows with the Redis 8.12 set member expiration, sorted set move,`BITRANGEINTARRAY` and `BLESS` commands. Many fixes land for reconnection, the selected database, Cluster pipelines and autopipelining, Sentinel and RESP3 decoding.

### 🚀 New Features
- client: smart client handoffs, which handle Redis maintenance notifications with the `maintNotifications`, `maintEndpointType`, `maintRelaxedCommandTimeout` and `maintRelaxedSocketTimeout` options ([#2165](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2165))
- cluster: add a health check for sharded subscribers, configured with `shardedSubscriberHealthCheckInterval` (default `10000` ms, `null` disables it) ([#2268](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2268))
- cluster: add the `subscriberNodeRole` option to choose the node role for the Pub/Sub subscriber ([#2176](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2176))
- commands: add the set member expiration commands `SADDEX`, `SEXPIRE`, `SEXPIREAT`, `SEXPIRETIME`, `SPERSIST`, `SPEXPIRE`, `SPEXPIREAT`, `SPEXPIRETIME`, `SPTTL` and `STTL` (Redis 8.12) ([#2261](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2261))
- commands: add the sorted set move commands `ZMOVE`, `BZMOVE` and `ZMOVEMEMBER` (Redis 8.12), with `BZMOVE` handled as a blocking command ([#2288](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2288))
- commands: add `BITRANGEINTARRAY` (Redis 8.12) ([#2279](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2279))
- commands: add the BLESS command family (Redis 8.12) ([#2209](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2209))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

**Connection and reconnection**
- End the client when `quit()` or `disconnect()` is called while reconnecting ([#2245](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2245))
- Reset retry attempts when `connect()` is called after the client gave up ([#2204](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2204))
- Reset the manual close state when `connect()` is called after `end` ([#2250](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2250))
- Reject unfulfilled commands dropped on reconnect ([#2194](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2194))
- Handle rejections from auto-resubscribe and `SELECT` on reconnect ([#2187](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2187))
- Close the monitor connection when `monitor()` rejects ([#2247](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2247))

**Selected database**
- Keep the selected database for commands queued while reconnecting ([#2235](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2235))
- Restore the database selected by a non-lowercase `SELECT` after reconnecting ([#2248](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2248))
- Handle a rejection from the database-restoring `SELECT` on `reconnectOnError` ([#2229](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2229))

**Cluster lifecycle**
- Fix the cluster getting stuck in `close` ([#2217](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2217))
- End when `quit()` or `disconnect()` is called while reconnecting ([#2240](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2240))
- Stay ended when nodes removed by `disconnect()` end late ([#2237](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2237))
- Stop refreshing slots when `disconnect()` is called during a refresh ([#2249](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2249))
- Do not fall back to a replica when no primary is left ([#2275](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2275))
- Map every slot when `stringNumbers` is enabled ([#2255](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2255))
- Pass the retry delay to the `reconnecting` event ([#2291](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2291))

**Cluster pipelines and autopipelining**
- Resend only the redirected command in a pipeline ([#2214](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2214))
- Do not reject pipeline commands for connecting nodes when the offline queue is disabled ([#2277](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2277))
- Do not throw when autopipelining meets an uncached slot ([#2233](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2233))
- Bucket autopipelined `MSET` objects by their first key ([#2207](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2207))
- Hash autopipelined `Buffer` keys by their bytes ([#2208](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2208))
- Hash lone surrogates as the UTF-8 that Node sends ([#2242](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2242))
- Vendor `cluster-key-slot` to fix the slot of keys with an empty hash tag ([#2172](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2172))
- Align autopipeline callbacks for dynamic commands ([#2180](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2180))

**Cluster Pub/Sub**
- Keep forwarding sharded messages after reconnecting from `end` ([#2251](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2251))
- Support a zero-argument `SUNSUBSCRIBE` with sharded subscribers ([#2137](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2137))
- Match `Buffer` shard channels when unsubscribing ([#2203](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2203))
- Emit sharded subscriber connect errors silently ([#2241](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2241))
- Inherit `connectTimeout` for cluster subscribers ([#2220](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2220))

**Sentinel**
- Retry unreachable sentinels in a loop instead of recursing ([#2270](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2270))
- Correct the retry order after node connection failures ([#2246](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2246))
- Handle errors on failover detector connections ([#2257](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2257))
- Clean up failover subscriptions after `quit()` ([#2198](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2198))

**Pub/Sub**
- Keep subscriber mode while other channel kinds remain subscribed ([#2196](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2196))
- Resolve an argument-less `UNSUBSCRIBE` / `PUNSUBSCRIBE` once its own kind is empty ([#2238](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2238))

**RESP and replies**
- Decode RESP3 attribute replies instead of failing the connection ([#2213](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2213))
- Decode RESP3 doubles with `Number` ([#2150](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2150))
- Decode integer replies up to `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` exactly ([#2164](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2164))
- Keep `String.prototype` in fast mode after defining `VerbatimString` ([#2206](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2206))
- Apply the legacy reply shape to uppercase command names ([#2252](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2252))

**Commands and errors**
- Redact credentials from the command attached to errors ([#2231](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2231))
- Keep the `exec()` error out of its own `previousErrors` ([#2218](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2218))
- Preserve empty keys and `MATCH` patterns in scan streams ([#2199](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2199))

**Types**
- Accept field arrays in `hmget` / `hmgetBuffer` ([#2167](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2167))
- Accept `string | string[]` for `del` ([#2230](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2230))
- Allow a number for the `zrange` stop argument ([#2163](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2163))
- Accept the documented TLS profile options ([#2195](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2195))
- Add event overloads to the `Cluster` interface ([#2201](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2201))
- Add `smessage` and `smessageBuffer` event overloads ([#2191](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2191))

### 🧰 Maintenance
- ci: publish to npm with trusted publishing and staged approval, and run the release job in the `Release` environment ([#2226](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2226), [#2303](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2303))
- ci: update the Redis 8.12 test image ([#2273](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2273), [#2287](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2287))
- test: run the standard functional suite against an external Redis Enterprise database and skip incompatible suites ([#2140](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2140), [#2177](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2177))
- test: add regression coverage for a deeply nested reply, subscribing during connect and `+switch-master` during Sentinel rediscovery ([#2138](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2138), [#2202](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2202), [#2293](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2293))
- test: tolerate early timer firing in timeout relaxation baselines ([#2232](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2232))
- docs: explain per-master cluster key scanning, fix multi-node cluster examples and correct the `slotsRefreshInterval` default ([#2295](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2295), [#2271](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2271), [#2236](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2236))
- docs: clarify Sentinel TLS options, list all built-in argument transformers and explain custom script inheritance in duplicate connections ([#2292](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2292), [#2290](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2290), [#2225](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2225))
- docs: update the contribution guidelines ([#2188](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2188))
- chore: remove the `CLAUDE.md` symlink in favour of `AGENTS.md` and remove the maintainer-review agent skill ([#2200](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2200), [#2244](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2244))
- deps: bump `undici`, `brace-expansion`, `serialize-javascript`, `mocha`, `handlebars`, `js-yaml`, `browserslist` and `@babel/core` ([#2173](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2173), [#2175](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2175), [#2179](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2179), [#2184](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2184), [#2185](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2185), [#2210](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2210), [#2216](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2216), [#2224](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2224), [#2263](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2263), [#2265](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2265))
- deps: bump `express`, `body-parser`, `qs`, `morgan` and `proxy-addr` in `examples/express` ([#2174](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2174), [#2183](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2183), [#2211](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2211), [#2223](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2223), [#2234](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2234), [#2264](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2264))

## ioredis@6.1.0-beta.1

### ✨ Highlights

This beta adds smart client handoffs ([SCH](https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/sch/)), which let the client ride through planned Redis server maintenance without interrupting service. It also adds the BLESS command family and an option to choose which node role cluster Pub/Sub subscribers connect to. Alongside these are a large set of fixes across cluster auto-pipelining, sharded Pub/Sub, reconnection handling and RESP3 decoding, plus several TypeScript type corrections.

### 🚀 New Features
- client: add smart client handoffs ([#2165](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2165))
- client: add the BLESS command family ([#2209](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2209))

**Sentinel**
- Clean up Sentinel failover subscriptions after `quit` ([#2198](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2198))

**Pub/Sub**

**Pipelines and transactions**
- Align auto-pipeline callbacks for dynamic commands ([#2180](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2180))
- Keep the `EXEC` error out of its own `previousErrors` ([#2218](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2218))

**Command arguments**
- Preserve empty keys and `MATCH` patterns in scan streams ([#2199](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2199))

**RESP decoding**
- Decode integer replies up to `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` exactly ([#2164](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2164))
- Decode RESP3 doubles with `Number` ([#2150](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2150))

**Types**

- Allow a number for the `zrange` stop argument ([#2163](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2163))

- Add event overloads to the `Cluster` interface ([#2201](https://github.com/redis/ioredis/pull/2201))

# [5.0.0](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/compare/v4.28.5...v5.0.0) (2022-03-26)

In the update of v5, we've made ioredis even more stable and developer-friendly while minimizing the number of breaking changes, so you can spend more time enjoying your life 😄.

Please refer to the guideline to upgrade your projects: [🚀 Upgrading from v4 to v5](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/wiki/Upgrading-from-v4-to-v5).

### Bug Fixes

* add @ioredis/interface-generator to dev deps ([aa3b3e9](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/aa3b3e91a369526ea2dff39b0619b0c2e0b4153b))
* add missing declaration for callBuffer ([08c9072](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/08c9072b24fa301401d424494c1ec8cde7ccf78b))
* add the missing typing for Redis#call() ([747dd30](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/747dd305696bf3fb661c1d0b4ac376de55e0ec25))
* better support for CJS importing ([687d3eb](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/687d3eb8dd0499fd900ede2f4dff835981999665))
* disable slotsRefreshInterval by default ([370fa62](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/370fa625cd20bfe62f41c38088e596c7a6f0619c))
* Fix the NOSCRIPT behavior when using pipelines ([bc1b168](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/bc1b1680663216ca2cfb1c77622bfa4fec9b2bd4))
* improve typing for auto pipelining ([4e8c567](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/4e8c567d1175de31e2371a9dad308a94fcb5627f))
* improve typing for pipeline ([d18f3fe](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/d18f3fe07ed04da5b7b26981d91bb4aa74b83ca3))
* keyPrefix should work with Buffer ([6942cec](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/6942cecd8a463756468988cf50a94c68298d3bfc)), closes [#1486](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/issues/1486)

* remove dropBufferSupport option ([04e68ac](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/04e68ac4ade14d68809ca58d7ad8536eceda2b1e))
* remove unused Command#isCustomCommand ([46ade6b](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/46ade6b8732b112cc5cffb641b1bab51eb96df38))
* rename interfaces by dropping prefix I ([d1d9dba](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/d1d9dba9eafc574a9d9041fd4bc7cd04f1584159))
* Reset loaded script hashes to force a reload of scripts after reconnect of redis ([60c2af9](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/60c2af985a994a247d1148bfab122e5c0ecd81d2))
* support passing keyPrefix via redisOptions ([6b0dc1e](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/6b0dc1e0edbaa5f46b7b03629dda20176c7a81b4))


### Features

* add [@since](https://github.com/since) to method comments ([13eff8e](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/13eff8e86a0d08a3aa614f2d8fe7a166f6beb532))
* add declarations for methods ([1e10c95](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/1e10c95eadede949e536f02ca1412ef4383ba654))
* add tests for cluster ([1eba58b](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/1eba58ba3961e477c6502daf05cf4074f728d3cf))
* always parse username passed via URI ([c6f41f6](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/c6f41f692243129dbc952ef8fd2e5c160133d677))
* drop support of Node.js 10 ([f9a5071](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/f9a5071d95519c0f358c4ecf064838824ce8ad62))
* drop support of third-party Promise libraries ([2001ec6](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/2001ec6fafd057eda9111ab858c1c618d939371e))
* expose official declarations ([7a436b1](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/7a436b128c3e97586d2378149beaa2043eb00850))
* improve typings for cluster ([06782e6](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/06782e681500eae6f3ceafcc6385b9be4fdaf4e3))
* improve typings for pipeline ([334242b](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/334242b1adf5399a1ad9d7ba6202d062a0695882))
* improve typings for smismember ([487c3a0](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/487c3a07e6080070d365e09dae75bbbc4267b619))
* improve typings for transformers ([94c1e24](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/94c1e24f09b9e7eaff4181f984f6317acacade94))
* improve typings for xread ([96cc335](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/96cc33590a8c2494b730d33780668a86cdd405cf))
* Pipeline-based script loading ([8df6ee2](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/8df6ee265595f035cc85b52b4d11793bea0318f3))
* prepare v5 stable release ([#1538](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/issues/1538)) ([fe32ce7](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/fe32ce71cbfb49b133834f1c4858ec0ca20ad6e8))
* Refactor code with modern settings ([a8ffa80](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/a8ffa80dd2fb081012222a436d5be2b5325623b9))
* skip ready check on NOPERM error ([b530a0b](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/b530a0b9fe0f987d6786e5cfccbfae8b5b9c9294)), closes [#1293](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/issues/1293)
* support commands added in Redis v7 ([53ca412](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/53ca41264f94f05a9a7a231915a0e852a46079d4))
* support defining custom commands via constructor options ([f293b97](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/f293b978c6023b8ce3477af0076203c7bc2482f8))
* support Redis Functions introduced in Redis 7.0 ([32eb381](https://github.com/luin/ioredis/commit/32eb381c3035ebc70e8e316697c7e0b479ec66a2))


### BREAKING CHANGES

* `slotsRefreshInterval` is disabled by default,
previously, the default value was 5000.
* `allowUsernameInURI` is removed and ioredis will always
use the username passed via URI.
Previously, the `username` part in `new Redis("redis://username:authpassword@127.0.0.1:6380/4")`
was ignored unless `allowUsernameInURI` is specified: `new Redis("redis://username:authpassword@127.0.0.1:6380/4?allowUsernameInURI=true")`.
Now, if you don't want to send username to Redis, just leave the username part empty:
`new Redis("redis://:authpassword@127.0.0.1:6380/4")`
* `Redis#serverInfo` is removed. This field is never documented so
you very likely have never used it.
* Support for third-party Promise libraries is dropped. Related methods (`exports.Promise = require('bluebird')`) are kept but they don't take any effects. The native Promise will always be used.
* We now require Node.js v12 or newer.
* `Redis` can't be called as a function anymore as it's now a class.
Please change `Redis()` to `new Redis()`. Note that `Redis()` was already deprecated
in the previous version.
